prose: THE LANE — the gurukul's straight downhill flight-courtyard slope of paper flagstones, 60 m long and 8 m wide, falling 9 m from top to bottom, with low paper kerbs on both sides. Fixed landmarks, always in these places: STONE POST (the rope tie-point at the top of the slope, on the LEFT kerb); CART START (where the tethered cart stands); MARKER 1 (first red marker, centreline); MARKER 2 (second red marker, centreline); MARKER 3 (third and last red marker, centreline); FLAT BEGINS (the slope ends; the last 12 m is level); GA-STONE (the flat stone where the golden ga-shape is forged); END WALL (closed paper stone wall across the full width — the lane is a dead end)
